## #1 — GuyBrown — 2007-03-08
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/1415/post-8926>

Shell script

Hi folks, 

In the process of learning Javascript I wrote a little program to generate sea shells (so I guess it's a shell script :smile. It may not be terribly efficient, but hopefully will be of some use to somebody out there. I also enclose an image of the output.

You need to drop it into the scripts > Polygonobj directory.

Cheers

Guy
